generate_translations_with_beam_search: create a SequenceGenerator with beam search to generate translations from a source sentence batch
generate_with_sampling: build a SequenceGenerator using sampling mode with top-k and top-p constraints for diverse output
generate_with_diverse_beam_search: create a SequenceGenerator with diverse beam search groups to produce varied translation hypotheses
ensemble_model_forward_decoder: run the EnsembleModel forward_decoder method to get averaged log probabilities and attention scores across models
reorder_encoder_output: use EnsembleModel reorder_encoder_out to reorder encoder outputs when beam search reorders hypotheses
